newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Spot prices mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Spot prices mostly steady.

text.p: Spot millfeed prices were mostly steady on Monday as several dealers noted an increase of nearby demand at the start of a quiet Christmas holiday week.
"We are fielding a lot of phone calls because of demand," one dealer said, referring to the shortness of supply from flour mill downtimes.
Supplies were also tight in Minneapolis. "I do not have it (midds), and if I did, I could sell it," a Minneapolis dealer said.
In Texas, most of the activity was in the nearbys, a broker said.
